topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: They told me about the change, the shift to another part of the forest. It’s a new territory, with different whispers in the air and shadows that dance to their own rhythm. I’ve walked this place, familiar with every scuffle and rustle, but now, I see it as a stepping stone, a trail I’ve blazed through patience and perseverance. The new ground will know my steps soon enough, and I carry with me the strength of what I’ve learned. This move, it’s not just a change; it’s a validation of the path I’ve taken, a silent nod from the trees themselves. I am ready, and I will thrive there, as I have thrived here.
